messages:
ana: Quick check — ready to scale the paid pulse across search + retarget for the next 2 weeks? Need budgets, creatives, and webinar reg flow hooked up. :rocket:

mike: Yup. Search daily cap set to $2.2k, retarget $600. We'll auto-shift 10% daily if CPI < $25.

ravi: Sharing current creative heads: A1/A2 headlines, dynamic price token, and webinar CTA. Which audience buckets do we prioritize for cross-sell?

sophie: Primary buckets = trialers, inactive-30-90, product-fit-high. Push webinar to trialers + high-fit retarget; keep inactive on a lower-frequency drip.

jamal: Creative refresh ready — 3 hero images + 2 short vids. Variants below:
```
H1: "Cut inference costs by 3x — See live demo"
H2: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — Webinar"
Desc: "Join 30 min demo + Q&A — Wed 11AM PT"
CTA: "Reserve Spot"
```

ana: For search: H1 on Exact/top intent, H2 on Broad & RLSA. Retarget: video-first for 7-day engagers, image ads for 30-90 day.

mike: UTM scheme for analytics (please paste into landing):
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=paid_pulse&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative}
```
Landing should also append `?source=paid_pulse` so we can route regs.

ravi: Tiny pacing rule: if spend hits 80% of daily by 18:00 PT, bump budget +10%. If CPI rises >10% vs baseline, hold.

sophie: Routing ask — can we send webinar registrants to SDR queue 'Paid-Webinar' with tag 'paid_pulse_high_intent'? Need CRM rule.

jamal: CRM rule confirmed: if utm_campaign=paid_pulse AND lead_source=ads AND tag=webinar_reg => assign to Paid-Webinar queue. I'll add the tag mapping today.

ana: Monitoring — want a slack alert to #marketing when CPC > $28 or CTR < 0.6% across search top campaigns. Who owns the alerts? :eyes:

mike: I can wire AdsBot. Sample command to set live monitor:
```
/adsbot monitor set --channel #marketing --metric cpc --threshold 28 --window 30m
/adsbot monitor set --channel #marketing --metric ctr --threshold 0.6 --window 30m
```

ravi: Also proposing a small canary: require 500 clicks before auto-scaling budgets. Avoids noisy early shifts.

sophie: Timeline check — creative goes live tmrw 9:00 PT, search updates 10:00 PT, retarget creatives get pushed at 11:00 PT, webinar landing + routing by EOD.

ana: Perfect. I'll post a launch checklist and pin it in the channel. :thumbsup:

ads-bot: Campaign 'paid_pulse_crosschannel' created (id: 89721) — status: scheduled.

jamal: One more — set frequency cap 3/day for retarget video to limit fatigue.

ana: Good call. Ok team — sync in stand if anything breaks. Thanks!
